The Data store role and data-edge kind are present in the common binding source but have no corresponding editable Miro slots, as recorded by retained-only projection diagnostics.
The synthetic native witness records shape-boundary endpoint attachments and exact control points; these are witness facts, not claims about an original private Miro board.
originalEvidence.scope: The witnesses are synthetic and do not establish deployment semantics. The JPEG is actual output from Miro for the synthetic document, not a capture of an original private board.
